model_comparison: Used generated model only as provisional construction continuity. Its own fine hair marks do not authorize curly finish. Photographs control actual identity.

findings.identity_grooming: Neet retains fine legs, full narrow fawn body, projecting cream muzzle, broad triangular ears and short nub. Buddy has moderate torso elongation, real leg clearance, a narrow dark tail and regional light face/feet. Broad body planes use diffuse pigment mottling with smooth contours; no material long or curled coat structure observed.
findings.anatomy_support: Buddy head lowers through a continuous neck and shoulder; all four feet belong to his torso and contact the sunny tiles. Neet has four separately readable supported legs and a connected neck/chest/pelvis. No floating or merged feet.
findings.scale_perspective: Separated dogs occupy a coherent tile plane with compatible contact shadows; Buddy nearer left, Neet farther right. No material perspective defect.
findings.scene_comedy_finish: Buddy appraises his limited sunny patch while Neet looks into the expansive kite-filled sky. No fallen kite is present, matching the placement after Perfect. Cream parapet, plant pots and skyline establish the terrace. Clean finished picture with distinct spatial comic contribution.

findings.identity_grooming: Actual v008 inspected at native 1448x1086. Both broad coat surfaces are now flat opaque color shapes with broad shadows. The repeated winding engraved ridges on Buddy flank/shoulder and Neet back are gone. Buddy facial, ear and foot furnishings remain regional; Neet retains smooth fawn body, broad triangular ears, cream muzzle/chest and tiny nub. No new shag volume.
findings.anatomy_support: Rechecked all eight paws and leg roots rather than assuming edit preservation. Neet has two forepaws visibly bracing the paper and two supported hind feet with continuous chest/back/pelvis. Buddy four supported feet remain individually owned by his connected full torso. Limb clearance, neck connection, braced stance and floor shadows are credible.
findings.bite_contact: Neet mouth still clamps the lifted purple kite corner. Paper rises continuously toward the muzzle; tear, frame and paw pressure remain readable. No free-floating bite prop or premature removal of the paper.
findings.scale_perspective_scene: Same coherent rooftop floor, parapet, sky kites, plants and separate loose spool thread. Dogs remain separate; Buddy behind left and Neet front right. No content imported from the finish reference. Image still depicts paper tug before detached corner is taken.
findings.comedy_finish: Neet determined paper battle and Buddy cautious watching remain clear. Flat cel/gouache coat finish is visibly simpler than the other two images, but deliberate, clean and compatible with the painted setting; it does not obscure identity, action or anatomy. Overall style remains provisional. No material regression observed.

findings.identity_grooming: Full narrow smooth tan Neet torso, large triangular ears, projecting pale muzzle and tiny nub remain recognizable. Buddy maintains substantial legs, a continuous elongated charcoal torso, pale moustache/brows/chest regions and hanging ears. Light diffuse body grain remains within watercolor treatment without the pronounced looping relief in kite-bite v007.
findings.anatomy_support: Eight feet have clear ownership and tile contact. Both open mouths have readable jaws; upward heads connect through continuous necks. Buddy close rear leg and Neet adjacent paw remain distinct; no merged support or extra limbs.
findings.scale_perspective: Low camera and contact shadows plausibly support the two separate dogs. Buddy nearer left is larger in the composition; no calibrated actual size claim is inferred.
findings.scene_comedy_finish: Both dogs join the cheer before Neet starts strutting. Golden kite floats free with a short loose cut filament; the hand-held spool line exits the frame separately. Cropped human hand is provisional and not treated as likeness. Plants, skyline and parapet carry the same terrace. Joyful mouths/gazes add a distinct payoff to the sunbeam setup and kite bite.

review_history.decision: Two images pass; kite-bite illustration-v007 rejected for residual structured coat texture. Anatomy and scene strengths do not cancel that defect.

findings.identity_grooming: Silhouettes and regional colors remain recognizable, with fine Neet legs/nub and Buddy furnished muzzle/brows/ears. However repeated small curled, worm-like and engraved ridges remain across Buddy flank and shoulder (approximately x180-470,y270-500), and a shallower similar pattern across Neet back/rump (x1040-1220,y370-510). These marks read as structured curly surface rather than a close smooth coat.
findings.texture_distinction: The roof, wall and sky legitimately have broad irregular pigment blooms. The rejected body texture instead has many repeated narrow winding ridges/loops. It does not add a large shag silhouette, but does materially change the perceived coat surface. Inspection of the complete native 1448x1086 image and an enlarged diagnostic crop confirmed this. Smooth outer silhouettes alone do not cure it.
findings.anatomy_support: The basic construction works: Neet mouth visibly grips the lifted paper corner, two forepaws brace on the kite, hind legs have distinct roots and support, and the raised rump connects through a full torso. Buddy has four credible legs and paws with ground clearance; no shared limbs.
findings.scale_perspective: Dogs and kite share a coherent tiled floor and shadows. Buddy stands behind left. Kite spars and torn paper are readable; loose thread remains separate from limbs.
findings.scene_comedy_finish: The exaggerated paper victory and Buddy cautious reaction are specific and effective; image depicts tugging before the piece is removed, at its intended anchor. Setting is coherent. Keep this construction and gag, but the material surface finish remains unacceptable.

open_findings.required_change: Remove the repeated engraved curls/loops on both broad body surfaces, especially Buddy shoulder/flank, using genuinely continuous restrained pigment washes. Preserve anatomy, pose, mouth-paper contact, paws, colors, furnishings and scene. Independently inspect the actual replacement at native resolution; a prompt or self-review cannot close this finding.

closed_findings.evidence: Native-resolution inspection confirms smooth flat body paint replacing engraved loops, with anatomy/support/paper-contact/scene rechecked.
